id: title:jonmcwest:measure the volume rollup from the tick

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a preview and measurement capability for the Logs volume tick rollup workflow, including execution entry points, allowlist checks, and regression tests.
review.reason: The chunk adds a preview-only SQL query and execution entry point, along with allowlist checks and execution limits, and includes regression and correctness checks. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. observations.behavior: Adds a new module, aggregation.py, containing a preview-only SQL query and its execution. P1.F2.H1: P1.F2.H1 adds the RollupPreview class, the _rollup_sql and _preview_sql functions, and the preview_rollup entry point. P1.F2.H1 also adds the TEAM_ALLOWLIST and its parsing, and the _ROLLUP_QUERY_SETTINGS with execution time and byte limits. P1.F1.H1: P1.F1.H1 imports the new module,
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the allowlist is empty and returns early, avoiding the query. P1.F1.H3: P1.F1.H3 adds the check and the preview execution, and the TimedRollupPreview class.

observations.behavior: Adds a new metric, record_rollup_duration, and record_rollup_preview, and updates the metrics configuration. P1.F4.H1: P1.F4.H1 adds the new metric names to the configuration.
